options_evaluated: Post-consumer recycled (PCR) Polypropylene (PP) monomaterial with molded-in textures
High-impact virgin ABS/PC blend with thick-walled construction
decisions.conflict: Material and Design recommends PCR PP monomaterial for circularity, whereas In-Service rejects this because PCR PP has lower impact strength and scratch resistance compared to high-impact virgin ABS/PC.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: material circularity vs mechanical durability
decisions.chief_resolution: Post-consumer recycled (PCR) Polypropylene (PP) monomaterial with molded-in textures. While virgin ABS/PC offers higher impact resistance, PCR PP significantly reduces the carbon footprint and is highly recyclable; mechanical durability will be addressed through structural design and ribbing.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the mechanical properties and shrinkage rates of available PCR PP grades to determine if structural ribbing can compensate for lower tensile strength without increasing tooling reject rates.

options_evaluated: Reversible snap-fits and standardized removable metal screws
Ultrasonic welding and permanent chemical adhesives
decisions.conflict: Circularity recommends snap-fits and removable screws for easy disassembly, whereas In-Service demands threaded fasteners with brass inserts for repeated repair durability, and Manufacture prefers pure snap-fits to avoid secondary assembly steps.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: ease of disassembly vs joint durability under vibration
decisions.chief_resolution: Reversible snap-fits and standardized removable metal screws. This option avoids permanent metal inserts (brass) which contaminate plastic recycling streams, while still allowing non-destructive disassembly for repair, unlike pure snap-fits which are prone to breaking.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the wear resistance of plastic screw boss designs under repeated disassembly to confirm if standardized metal screws can be used without stripping the plastic threads.

options_evaluated: Modular BLDC motor with mechanically fastened rare-earth magnets and slide-out copper stator
Synchronous reluctance motor without rare-earth magnets
decisions.conflict: Circularity recommends a modular BLDC motor with mechanically fastened magnets for recycling, while In-Service recommends a standard high-efficiency BLDC motor for performance, and Manufacture recommends a ferrite-magnet motor to avoid rare-earth mining impacts.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: critical raw material recovery vs use-phase energy efficiency
decisions.chief_resolution: Modular BLDC motor with mechanically fastened rare-earth magnets and slide-out copper stator. This ensures the high power density and efficiency required for vacuum performance (engineering feasibility) while allowing the non-destructive recovery of critical rare-earth magnets and copper at end-of-life.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the assembly complexity and safety of mechanical fastening methods for rare-earth magnets in high-speed BLDC rotors to ensure structural integrity at operating RPMs.

options_evaluated: Bypass active cooling fan integrated with main suction airflow and removable aluminum fins
Passive cooling via optimized airflow channels and bio-based thermal conductive plastics
Active cooling loop with liquid coolant
decisions.conflict: In-Service recommends an active bypass cooling fan to prevent thermal degradation of the motor, whereas Material and Circularity recommend passive cooling to reduce weight and avoid unrecyclable potting compounds.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: thermal reliability vs material simplicity
decisions.chief_resolution: Bypass active cooling fan integrated with main suction airflow and removable aluminum fins. Passive cooling is insufficient for high-power vacuum motors, making active cooling an engineering necessity; using removable aluminum fins avoids unrecyclable potting compounds and allows clean material separation.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the aerodynamic design and sealing requirements of the bypass cooling duct to ensure dirty suction air does not contaminate the motor electronics.

options_evaluated: Modular architecture with tool-less user-replaceable battery, motor, and filter cartridges
Monolithic integrated chassis with potted electronics
decisions.conflict: Manufacture recommends a monolithic integrated design to minimize tooling energy and scrap, whereas In-Service and Circularity demand a modular architecture with user-replaceable parts to facilitate repair and extend product life.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing simplicity vs repairability and lifetime extension
decisions.chief_resolution: Modular architecture with tool-less user-replaceable battery, motor, and filter cartridges. Extending the product's useful life through easy repair has a significantly lower overall lifecycle environmental impact than minimizing initial manufacturing tooling complexity.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the structural weight penalty and assembly tolerances of modular interlocking joints to ensure the vacuum maintains structural integrity and airtight seals.

options_evaluated: Removable and modular Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) battery pack
Corded AC power (mains) with an automatic cord reel
decisions.conflict: Manufacture recommends corded AC power to completely eliminate battery manufacturing footprints, whereas In-Service and Circularity recommend a removable battery pack to provide cordless portability while ensuring the battery is replaceable.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing footprint of energy storage vs use-phase portability
decisions.chief_resolution: Removable and modular Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) battery pack. While corded power has a lower manufacturing footprint, cordless operation is a critical market requirement; LFP chemistry avoids toxic cobalt/nickel and offers a significantly longer cycle life than standard Li-ion.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the volumetric energy density of LFP cells to determine if the battery pack size and weight remain acceptable for a handheld or stick vacuum cleaner.
